source.title: Open problems in the theory of the Navier-Stokes equations for viscous incompressible flow

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/4188345 for document identifier 4188345. Local workflow shard metadata and Crossref identify the exact work as John G. Heywood, 'Open problems in the theory of the Navier-Stokes equations for viscous incompressible flow,' Lecture Notes in Mathematics 1431, pages 1-22, DOI 10.1007/bfb0086051.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted. The DOI and Springer landing page resolve to the exact chapter, but the full chapter PDF redirects to an access-controlled Springer page rather than a readable full-text PDF.

Identifier-specific recovery checked Crossref and OpenAlex. Crossref exposed only Springer DOI/PDF resource links for the published version, and OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.

Bounded exact-work searches used the exact title, exact DOI, and exact title plus PDF/author terms. Inspected candidates were Springer metadata/table-of-contents pages, bibliographic records, book-retailer table-of-contents pages, or unrelated later works. A Springer preview PDF for the exact chapter contained only pages 1-2 of the 22-page chapter, so it was rejected as an incomplete artifact rather than a readable full-text source for extracting all problems.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work full PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, Crossref/OpenAlex metadata, search snippets, bibliographic table-of-contents pages, retailer pages, or an incomplete publisher preview when the full problem source is access restricted.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with complete source coverage and page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable full-text primary source.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/4188345.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
